# Data in this repository

*Generated by `python3 tools/data_inventory.py`; every data file must be classified there, or the check fails.*

Everything here is **synthetic** or **derived from synthetic inputs**, made by this project. No survey data and no data from any simulation suite are included.
The toy volume is a Zel'dovich-approximation stand-in, not a hydrodynamic simulation.
Validation outputs are written by the tests and read by the build: they are never typed by hand.
Nothing here is restricted: every file may be redistributed (column "redistributable"). The table shows the first 16 hex digits of each SHA-256; the full digests are in `docs/DATA.sha256` (from the repository root: `shasum -a 256 -c docs/DATA.sha256`).
